thread:
Priya (PM): Post meeting note: Pricing team wants clarity on how add-on limits interact with Dedicated capacity. Customer: enterprise fintech wants credits but also a per-route cap to protect latency SLA during spikes. Can we define behavior?
Sam (Engineering): Suggested flow: credits consumed account-wide, but route-level caps enforced by runtime. If credits exhausted account-wide, route enforcement still applies. Two enforcement modes: 1) contract-ceiling (hard deny), 2) graceful-degrade (apply lower max tokens/sec).
Hector (Finance): for accounting, credits need ledger entries tagged by 'use_case' so finance can reconcile per-route spend for chargebacks.
Rina (Legal): add clause: credits won't be transferrable across legal entities; require explicit parent account mapping. Also, for regulated customers, auto-topup requires PO or signed addendum.
analytics-bot: metric note: during last stress test with simulated bursts, enabling credits increased sustained qps by 22% before throttles.
Priya (PM): proposal for GA: - credits are account-level prepay units - runtime enforces route-level soft caps; when cap would be violated, if credits > 0 allow short burst up to topup_amount, otherwise respond with 402. - Billing: emit per-route ledger lines when route-level cap is used.
Sam (Engineering): minor hitch: need to decide idempotent top-up token to avoid double-charges from retries. Also need webhook for `topup.failed` with reason.
Hector (Finance): request: include `original_payment_method` and `invoice_ref` in topup event payload for audits.
Rina (Legal): note: include right-to-stop clause for customers to request suspension of auto-topups pending investigation.
Priya (PM): launch checklist row added: runtime policy doc, billing schema update, UI consent + audit log, sales FAQ.
Sam (Engineering): can we support a temporary emergency override (manual credit injection) via support console? ops will need RBAC change.
Hector (Finance): manual injections must be tracked as 'manual_adjustment' and require two-person approval for > $50k.
Priya (PM): ok captured. timeline: 6 weeks to GA if billing & runtime work parallelize. blockers: Rina to confirm addendum path; Sam to prototype idempotent topup.
